```yaml
name: Bundle Analyzer

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  analyze-bundle:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

    - name: Build and analyze bundle
      run: npm run build:analyze

    - name: Upload bundle analysis report as artifact
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
      with:
        name: bundle-analysis-report
        path: dist/bundle-analysis.html

    - name: Notify on Slack (optional)
      uses: onekeyhq/actions/slack-notify-webhook@main
      with:
        secret-key: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_SECRET }}
        web-hook-url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        artifact-type: html
        artifact-name: bundle-analysis-report
        artifact-bundle-id: lobehub-lobehub
        artifact-version-name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        artifact-version-code: ${{ github.run_number }}
        artifact-download-url: https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/artifacts/download?artifact_id=${{ steps.upload-artifact.outputs.artifact_id }}&token=${{ github.token }}
        artifact-bundle-version: ${{ github.sha }}
        artifact-skip-gpg: true
        artifact-build-source: github-actions
        artifact-branch: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        artifact-commit: ${{ github.sha }}
```
